days.name: Coach Log / Upper
days.note: Keep the rest of this session exactly as your coach prescribed. These are the competition-lift anchors we are carrying forward.

exercises.name: Competition Log C&P
exercises.note: Full clean and press. Do not add weight because it feels good.

exercises.name: Log Back-off
exercises.note: Quality volume; finish with reps in reserve.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Easy pace. Finish warm, not tired.

warmup.name: Banded lat stretch
warmup.note: Gentle hold; breathe into the ribcage.

warmup.name: Bench T-spine extension
warmup.note: Keep ribs controlled; open through the upper back.

warmup.name: Face pull + external rotation
warmup.note: Prime upper back and rotator cuff.

warmup.name: Log ramp-up
warmup.note: These are warm-up sets, not work sets. Add a small intermediate jump if anything feels stiff.

cardio.name: Zone 2 bike / incline walk
cardio.note: Optional this handover week; do not interfere with your coach's work.

days.name: Coach Deadlift / Back
days.note: Keep the rest of this session exactly as your coach prescribed.

exercises.name: Competition Deadlift
exercises.note: This is our baseline top set.

warmup.name: Half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Glute squeezed; avoid arching the lower back.

warmup.name: Hamstring floss
warmup.note: Move in and out of range rather than holding a deep stretch.

warmup.name: Deadlift ramp-up
warmup.note: These are warm-up sets, not work sets. Add a small intermediate jump if anything feels stiff.

days.name: Coach Leg Day
days.note: Follow your coach’s existing leg session this week.

warmup.name: Couch / hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Short relaxed holds only before lifting.

warmup.name: Goblet squat pry
warmup.note: Sit into position, breathe, then stand explosively.

days.name: Coach Support Day
days.note: Follow your coach’s existing support/events session this week.

warmup.name: World's greatest stretch
warmup.note: Flow through each position; do not force range.
